content:
sophie-peopleops: Heads-up 1: running a Mentor Appreciation Week (hybrid) in early Feb. Proposal: $100 mentor stipend + digital certificate + small social. Want to pilot with Engineering & Product mentors. Thoughts?
omar-hr: Love it. Quick policy check: stipends >$100 require payroll coding. $100 is borderline; will check with finance on tax treatment.
leah-culture: We should include a simple recognition slide deck + a Zoom toast. I can draft the deck.
diego-eng: Mentor community thumbs-up. Can we make it opt-in for mentors (so they accept stipend)? Some prefer a donation to team budget.
marta-finance: FYI, misc stipends are typically taxable; payroll will need a vendor code and a list of recipients by payroll ID. If under $150 it's still treated as wages. I'll confirm exact process.
kudos-bot: New nomination by izzy-recruiting "Chandra ran a stellar onboarding mentor session for hires last month" :sparkles:
izzy-recruiting: saving for the shoutouts list.
sophie-peopleops: Good point Diego  opt-in is a must. Also offer a choice: $100 stipend or $100 to team learning budget or a $25 charitable donation.
chandra-mentor: I prefer the stipend but happy to donate some to the learning fund. Small ask: would the stipend be a one-off or per-mentee?
sophie-peopleops: One-off per mentor for the week, not per mentee. Aim to recognize 40 mentors this pilot.
omar-hr: Recusal/panel note: if managers are on the selection panel they should recuse if they nominated someone. I'll add that to the panel charter blurb.
marta-finance: Action required from payroll: final recipient list, stipend amount, and budget code by Feb 1. Also need to know if physical certificates will be mailed (we need addresses).
leah-culture: I'll do digital certs and make a printable PDF for those who want physical copies. Small print run only if people opt in.
diego-eng: I'll ask Eng leads to send the list of mentors and confirm opt-in by Jan 25.
izzy-recruiting: Recruitment can help surface mentor-mentee pairings if you want metrics for the shoutouts.
sophie-peopleops: Proposed timeline: Jan 15 callout to mentors, Jan 25 opt-in deadline, Jan 28 payroll list to Marta, Feb 5 Mentor Week events + virtual toast, Feb 8 announce winners/shoutouts. OK?
marta-finance: Confirmed payroll deadline Jan 28 for Feb pay cycle. If list comes later it delays payment to next cycle.
chandra-mentor: Can we have a small spot-award pool for mentees who did great work during mentorship? Maybe 10*$50 e-gifts picked by mentors.
omar-hr: That could work; mentors can nominate mentees but must disclose relationship. Panel to approve mentee spot-awards.
leah-culture: Love the idea  adds reciprocity. We'll add a simple nomination form: nominee, reason (100 chars), nominator.
sophie-peopleops: Action items: 1) Sophie: create opt-in + nom form (link to be posted) 2) Diego/Leads: pull mentor list and confirm opt-in by Jan 25 3) Marta: confirm payroll workflow & tax note by EOD Tue 4) Leah: prep digital cert templates and event slides 5) Omar: draft panel recusal blurb. Reply here when done.
kudos-bot: Reminder set by kudos-bot "Opt-in deadline in 10 days"
izzy-recruiting: I'll help collate mentor-mentee highlights for the shoutouts slide.
marta-finance: Quick FYI: if mentors choose donation option we can automate a one-time transfer to team learning budget but need a proper vendor/GL code.
sophie-peopleops: Thanks all  I'll post the opt-in form link tomorrow and pin it. If anyone has objections to the stipend amount speak now or DM me. Tagging @here for visibility.
